Simera Sense
South Africa  |  Earth Observation Payloads
Contract Win
Canadian Earth observation company Galaxia has acquired one of Simera Sense's HyperScape100 hyperspectral imagers - a compact payload built for small satellites that pulls 32 user-selectable spectral bands from a library of 400. A neat example of how specialist payload makers are quietly becoming the backbone of the next generation of EO constellations.
🔗 Source: Simera Sense

UK Space Strategy
The UK government published its new Space Strategy on 8 September, committing £7.8bn through to 2030 across defence, security and economic growth. Space Park Leicester sits right at the centre of the innovation ecosystem this strategy is designed to grow.

Industry Spotlight
Ministry of Defence
UK  |  Government / Defence Procurement
Government Announcement
£880m of the new UK Space Strategy is earmarked specifically for space control and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance - tracking activity in orbit and identifying threats to satellites, out to 2030. This is exactly the defence procurement money Space-Comm exists to help commercial space companies get in front of.
🔗 Source: GOV.UK
👤 LinkedIn Post
The UK just put a number on how seriously it's taking space defence. £880m of the new £7.8bn UK Space Strategy is earmarked specifically for space control and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance - tracking activity in orbit and identifying threats to satellites, out to 2030. This is exactly the kind of budget line commercial space companies spend months trying to get in front of the people who control it. At Space-Comm Expo Europe, that's not a hope - MOD, UKSA and the primes delivering this strategy are in the room. If government or defence access is part of your growth plan, this is the moment to be talking to us.
